gpt-6-luna.description: GPT-6 Luna on OpenAI's Decisions API (public beta): text and images

setup.description: OpenAI API key (the same OPENAI_API_KEY the openai chat provider reads)
instructions: 1. Create an API key at https://platform.openai.com/api-keys
2. Set {apiKeyEnvVar}; it is shared with the openai chat provider

3. With no other decision provider configured, {apiKeyEnvVar} alone makes openai-decisions the default decision provider (a last resort, after every other one except ScaleDown, as PERPLEXITY_API_KEY does for perplexity-decider), unless OPENAI_BASE_URL, OPENAI_API_BASE or credentials.openai.baseURL names a host other than https://api.openai.com: the key is then taken to be a gateway's and is not used by default. To use it while another provider is configured, name it in a call (provider: "openai-decisions" or --provider openai-decisions), but only if the key is OpenAI's, because a named call sends the environment key to api.openai.com. Behind a gateway, route it on purpose with OPENAI_DECISIONS_BASE_URL or credentials.openaiDecisions, or do not use it
4. Optional: OPENAI_DECISIONS_BASE_URL (an origin) and OPENAI_DECISIONS_MODEL (default gpt-6-luna)
